notes:
Sourced primarily from Philips's own official 65BDL3652T/75BDL3652T/86BDL3652T user manual (documents.philips.com/assets/20240207/d628c01f9071428a9308b10f00b3b96c.pdf), which contains a numbered terminal-panel diagram (Section 3.2) and a detailed Technical Specifications table (Section 14) for the 65" model specifically. Cross-checked against the official 1-page Philips product datasheet (documents.philips.com/assets/20230607/3346518c364a4676b4c7b01a00c6c7f5.pdf) and the PPDS product page. Product is branded "Philips" though manufactured/sold by PPDS (a TP Vision/MMD joint venture under Philips license).

Omitted from the port list (not cable/AV connectors): a Micro SD card slot (supports up to 128GB) and a physical "Main Power Switch" rocker, both present on the unit.

"AC OUT" is an auxiliary AC pass-through outlet for powering an external media player; Philips documentation doesn't specify the exact IEC sub-type, so "iec" (C13/C14 family) was used as the closest match — treat this as inferred.

Power input rated 100-240V~, 50/60Hz, max consumption 350W (typical 175W). This model is part of a 3-size family (65"/75"/86" BDL3652T) sharing one manual and an identical I/O terminal set per the manual's own tables; only the 65" back panel/diagram was used to confirm exact physical layout here.

USB-C (labeled "USB 3.0 C" on the panel, supports display + touch) has no stated USB speed/version in Philips documentation, so grade was omitted rather than guessed. The two USB-B touch-return ports' USB 2.0 grade is inferred by cross-referencing the datasheet rather than being explicitly stated against those specific ports.
